europe.name: Europe
europe.text: Our home base. Cargo is collected, consolidated and dispatched from Berlin and across Europe.

north-africa.name: North Africa
north-africa.text: Direct corridors from Europe to the North African coast — among the shortest sea routes in our network.

west-africa.name: West Africa
west-africa.text: One of our strongest corridors, connecting European ports and airports with West African trade hubs.

central-africa.name: Central Africa
central-africa.text: Freight coordination into Central African markets, planned around reliable routing and careful handovers.

east-africa.name: East Africa
east-africa.text: Air and sea freight into East African gateways, with connections continuing to inland destinations.

southern-africa.name: Southern Africa
southern-africa.text: Containerised vehicle and commercial cargo routes into the southern corridor of the continent.

middle-east.name: Middle East
middle-east.text: Connecting European exporters with Gulf and Levant markets through dependable air and sea routes.
